item_short_desc: Rothco’s Universal Gun Cleaning Kit is the ultimate solution for maintaining and preserving the performance of your firearms. This comprehensive kit includes over 150 essential items, designed to clean everything from pistols to rifles, shotguns, and muzzleloaders. It features 6 solid brass rods, 14 bronze brushes, and 9 mops, making it versatile enough to accommodate nearly any barrel size. The kit also includes 12 spear-pointed jags, 1 black powder jag, and 4 slotted patch loops for attaching cleaning patches.
description: Rothco’s Universal Gun Cleaning Kit is the ultimate solution for maintaining and preserving the performance of your firearms. This comprehensive kit includes over 150 essential items, designed to clean everything from pistols to rifles, shotguns, and muzzleloaders. It features 6 solid brass rods, 14 bronze brushes, and 9 mops, making it versatile enough to accommodate nearly any barrel size. The kit also includes 12 spear-pointed jags, 1 black powder jag, and 4 slotted patch loops for attaching cleaning patches, ensuring thorough cleaning and maintenance. With 100 cleaning patches, 3 utility brushes, 3 muzzle guards, and 4 polishing cloths, this kit provides everything you need for a deep clean. The durable, compact hard plastic case keeps all components organized and easily portable, measuring 10.5 inch x 15.25 inch x 2 inch, making it perfect for on-the-go maintenance. Ensure your firearms are always in top condition with Rothco’s Universal Gun Cleaning Kit.
